description: n=829: the smallest n (found by an exhaustive sweep of n in [1,20000] with members generated by the documented rule) whose Binary Fuse 16 construction needs a SEED RETRY to converge — the first peel attempt (seed_0=0x66666b6c) fails, and the second attempt (seed=next32(seed_0)=0x049de525) succeeds. Frozen so a port can confirm its OWN peel/retry logic reaches the SAME seed for the SAME input, not just that some seed eventually works — a port whose retry/seed-advance order differs would produce a DIFFERENT (but possibly still-valid) blob here.
